test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Mary is __a ball of fire__ and is always engaged in something creative.

options.text: To be good and beneficial for someone

solution:
The correct answer is: **An active and energetic person**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"a ball of fire"** means an active and energetic person. (सक्रिय और ऊर्जावान व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite her age, Grandma is a ball of fire, always gardening or cooking something new.
 
 
 
• **Energetic** refers to someone who is full of energy and enthusiasm. (ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example:** The new coach is very energetic and has brought a lot of positive changes to the team.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
